from pathlib import Path
import difflib,hashlib,json,stat
root=Path.cwd()
base=Path('docs/agent-work/changeo-implementation')
r3=json.loads((base/'mercadopago-baseline.json').read_text())
original=json.loads((base/'baseline.json').read_text())
allowed=r3['allowed_deliverable_changes']
cumulative=r3['cumulative_original_source_changes']
fail=[]
remaining=[]
for rel,meta in original['files'].items():
 if rel in cumulative: continue
 ok=hashlib.sha256(Path(rel).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==meta['sha256']
 remaining.append({'path':rel,'unchanged':ok})
 if not ok: fail.append(rel)
preserved=[]
for rel,meta in r3['files'].items():
 if rel in allowed: continue
 ok=hashlib.sha256(Path(rel).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==meta['sha256']
 preserved.append({'path':rel,'unchanged':ok})
 if not ok: fail.append(rel)
protected=[]
for rel,meta in original['protected_metadata'].items():
 p=Path(rel)
 observed={'mode':oct(p.stat().st_mode),'entries':sorted(str(x.relative_to(p)) for x in p.rglob('*'))}
 ok=observed==meta
 protected.append({'path':rel,'unchanged':ok,'observed':observed})
 if not ok: fail.append(rel)
snapshots=[]
patch=[]
for rel in allowed:
 p=Path(rel)
 snap=base/'mercadopago-baseline'/rel
 old=snap.read_text()
 new=p.read_text()
 snapshots.append({'path':str(snap),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(snap.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'matches_pre_edit_hash':hashlib.sha256(snap.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==r3['files'][rel]['sha256']})
 if not snapshots[-1]['matches_pre_edit_hash']: fail.append(str(snap))
 patch.extend(difflib.unified_diff(old.splitlines(keepends=True),new.splitlines(keepends=True),fromfile='pre-R3/'+rel,tofile=rel))
Path('docs/agent-work/changeo-gate0/developer/mercadopago/logs/seven-file.patch').write_text(''.join(patch))
result={'workspace':str(root),'unaffected_original_count':len(remaining),'unaffected_originals':remaining,'r3_captured_files':len(r3['files']),'unchanged_r3_outside_deliverable_count':len(preserved),'unchanged_r3_outside_deliverable':preserved,'protected_metadata':protected,'seven_complete_snapshots':snapshots,'full_patch_lines':len(patch),'failures':fail}
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
raise SystemExit(1 if fail else 0)
